references.text: Jacob also asked the name of the one he had wrestled with at Jabbok, and received a similar answer that the name was wonderful/secret.
Moses asked God for his name at the burning bush, and God revealed himself as 'I am who I am', showing that God's name is mysterious and holy.
The Messiah is called 'Wonderful' (pele), the same Hebrew root as 'wonderful' (peli) in Judges 13:18, pointing to the mystery of the divine nature.
The question 'what is his name?' refers to the mystery surrounding God's identity and name, which the angel also alludes to in Judges 13:18.
Christ has a name that no one knows except himself, reflecting the secret and wonderful aspect of God's name in Judges 13:18.
